label: AA
price_note: Yahoo's AA series is Alcoa Inc. before 2016-11-01 and the spun-off Alcoa Corp. after it, so a position held across the spin-off would earn a different company's return. Excluded rather than trusted.

label: ADS
price_note: Alliance Data Systems was renamed Bread Financial (ADS to BFH) in 2022; same company.

label: ARNC
price_note: Arconic Inc. (the renamed Alcoa Inc.) became Howmet Aerospace on 2020-04-01, the change table's own row; Yahoo carries its history from 2016-11-01 under HWM.

label: BHI
price_note: Baker Hughes Inc. merged with GE Oil & Gas on 2017-07-07 (the change table's own BKR-for-BHI row); Yahoo carries Baker Hughes Inc.'s history under BKR, continuous across the merger date.

label: DISCA
price_note: Discovery, Inc. acquired WarnerMedia and was renamed Warner Bros. Discovery; Yahoo carries DISCA's history under WBD.

label: DPS
price_note: Dr Pepper Snapple Group was the surviving company in the 2018 Keurig merger and was renamed Keurig Dr Pepper; Yahoo carries its history under KDP.

label: DWDP
price_note: DowDuPont changed its ticker from DWDP to DD on 2019-06-03 (the change table's own row); Yahoo carries its history under DD.

label: FBHS
price_note: Fortune Brands Home & Security was renamed Fortune Brands Innovations (FBHS to FBIN) in December 2022, days before its removal.

label: FLT
price_note: FLEETCOR Technologies was renamed Corpay (FLT to CPAY), the change table's own 2024-03-25 row.

label: GPS
price_note: Gap Inc. changed its ticker from GPS to GAP in 2024; same company.

label: HFC
price_note: HollyFrontier reorganised as HF Sinclair (DINO) in 2022; Yahoo carries HollyFrontier's history under DINO.

label: Q
price_note: QuintilesIMS changed its ticker from Q to IQV (the change table's own 2017-11-15 row). Today's Q is Qnity Electronics, a different company.

label: SW
price_note: Yahoo's SW series before Smurfit Westrock began trading on 2024-07-08 is a flat-lined placeholder (the same close repeated for weeks at a time), not WestRock's or MeadWestvaco's real history. Membership before this date is kept; the price is not.

label: WLTW
price_note: Willis Towers Watson changed its ticker from WLTW to WTW, the change table's own 2022-01-10 row.

label: WYN
price_note: Wyndham Worldwide was renamed Wyndham Destinations and then Travel + Leisure Co.; the same company, with its history under TNL.
